highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.0 previews modern .NET support, updated Skia, and substantial API and platform improvements.
highlights_body: This preview line introduced the foundations of SkiaSharp v3, including updated native dependencies, broader view support, and modernized drawing APIs.

breaking.title: Legacy obsolete APIs were removed
breaking.body: Members previously marked obsolete are no longer available. Update code to the recommended replacement APIs before moving to the v3 preview packages.

bullets.detail: The v3 preview line refreshes the bundled graphics engine and native libraries for current rendering and text capabilities.
New span overloads for point mapping, polygons, and rounded-rectangle radii reduce allocations in high-throughput drawing code.
The preview adds .NET 9 support and broadens desktop, mobile, and WebAssembly view integration.

preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.5.4: Preview 5 completed the v3 API and dependency refresh work.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.4.1: Preview 4 expanded rendering and platform compatibility.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added API refinements and native build updates.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 focused on modern .NET and view integration.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.1.8: Preview 1 opened the SkiaSharp v3 line.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzzSharp alongside the SkiaSharp v3 preview line with current text-shaping support.
